technique_name: List the benefits of Amazon Web Services.
description: Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a cloud computing platform that provides a suite of services and infrastructure to organizations. Benefits of AWS include scalability, reliability, affordability, security, performance, and global availability. Additionally, AWS supports a range of operating systems and programming languages, offering users flexibility in how they build and deploy applications.
